title: Opening the report shows one row per in-stock part at the selected location(s), valued as of the resolved date
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Several ZZAUTOTEST parts with positive on-hand quantity exist at your active location.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Inventory Value report.
2. Compare the rows shown to the in-stock parts at the selected location(s).
3. Note the date range in the toolbar and which date the values represent.
custom_expected:
1. The report shows one row for each in-stock part at the selected location(s).
2. The values are valued as of the resolved date (the current stock for a range reaching today, or the closest recorded nightly snapshot for an earlier date — see the IV — As-of Date & Snapshots cases).
